findings.highlight: Fukagawa Yumi from the Public Policy Department
findings.explanation: Yumi is in the same Politics and Economics program as Setsuna. The English again changes 政経 to Public Policy, repeating the systematic academic-field error found elsewhere in the route.
findings.japanese:
『由美って覚えてる？　同じ政経の深川由美。
彼女の家に四人集まって、コピーの仕分けついでに、
一応、勉強もしておこうって話になってね』
findings.todokanai: "Do you know Yumi? Fukagawa Yumi from the Public Policy Department? The four of us gathered at her place, and after distributing our copied notes, we ended up studying for a bit too."

findings.highlight: You can text me anytime, except for when I'm in the middle of exams, bathing, or before I go to sleep
findings.evidenceJa: 試験中だろうが就寝中だろうが入浴中だろうが、メールしてくれるのは全然構わない
findings.explanation: Haruki says Setsuna may email him regardless of whether he is taking an exam, sleeping, or bathing—there is no inconvenient time. The English turns the emphatic inclusive list into exceptions when she must not text, exactly reversing the reassurance he adds to soften his cold first draft.
findings.japanese:
『試験中だろうが就寝中だろうが入浴中だろうが、
メールしてくれるのは全然構わない』
findings.todokanai: "You can text me anytime, except for when I'm in the middle of exams, bathing, or before I go to sleep."

findings.highlight: I slowly let out a sigh as Mari-san gives no resistance
findings.evidenceJa: 麻理さんは無抵抗なような、だからこそこちらの負荷が高いような、そんな緩慢な動作のまま、ゆっくりため息をつく。
findings.explanation: Mari, moving sluggishly and offering no resistance as Haruki supports her, is the one who slowly sighs. The English assigns the sigh to Haruki, removing one of the bodily signs that her conspicuous cheerfulness is collapsing into exhaustion and anxiety.
findings.japanese:
麻理さんは無抵抗なような、
だからこそこちらの負荷が高いような、
そんな緩慢な動作のまま、ゆっくりため息をつく。
findings.todokanai: I slowly let out a sigh as Mari-san gives no resistance, which only serves to make my efforts more difficult due to how sluggish her movements are.

findings.highlight: Back when I forcibly took Mari-san for myself
findings.evidenceJa: 強引に奪いかけてしまった俺のような行為
findings.explanation: Haruki compares Mari's present aggression to the time he almost forcibly took her as she was leaving. The English says he did forcibly take her, changing an interrupted near-assault into a completed act and materially altering their sexual history.
findings.japanese:
去っていこうとする麻理さんを、
強引に奪いかけてしまった俺のような行為。
findings.todokanai: Back when I forcibly took Mari-san for myself when she was about to leave me.

findings.highlight: I wouldn't let even the slightest changes that she exhibits go unnoticed
findings.evidenceJa: 相手の、そんなちょっとした変化に目くじらなんか立てていられない
findings.explanation: Because Haruki himself has maintained an ambiguous attitude, he says he is in no position to make an issue of Mari's slight change in behavior. The English says he refuses to let even the slightest change escape notice, reversing humility and restraint into vigilance.
findings.japanese:
俺だって、ずっと曖昧な態度を取り続けてるのに、
相手の、そんなちょっとした変化に
目くじらなんか立てていられない。
findings.todokanai: Even if I've been acting rather ambiguously around her all this time, I wouldn't let even the slightest changes that she exhibits go unnoticed.
